## Highlights

- **Admin UI**: MicroStack now serves a web UI at `http://localhost:4566/ui/` on the
  gateway port. It includes a searchable service directory, an account-aware
  read-only Resource Explorer, and an Overview with service health, resource
  counts, and a global reset. See [Internal API](https://damianh.github.io/microstack/internal-api).
- **Testcontainers support**: the container works with dynamically mapped ports
  from any Testcontainers client. Runnable .NET, Java, Go, Python, and TypeScript
  examples live in `examples/testcontainers` and are verified against the
  release image. See [Testing](https://damianh.github.io/microstack/testing).

## Upgrade notes

- **SQS queue URLs now follow the request.** By default, returned queue URLs use
  the caller's scheme, host, and port, so SDKs work unmodified behind dynamic
  port mappings. Queue identity is unchanged. To restore the previous behavior
  (URLs built from `MICROSTACK_HOST` and `GATEWAY_PORT`), set
  `MICROSTACK_SQS_ENDPOINT_STRATEGY=legacy`. See
  [Configuration](https://damianh.github.io/microstack/configuration).
- **`MICROSTACK_UI_PORT` and `MICROSTACK_API_URL` are obsolete.** The UI shares
  the gateway port; these settings are ignored and a warning is logged at
  startup if they are set.
- **Aspire users:** `MicroStack.Aspire.Hosting` uses the `latest` image tag, so
  the changes above apply as soon as the new image is pulled. Call
  `.WithImageTag("0.3.0")` on the resource to keep the previous behavior while
  migrating.
